aguinaldo.noHireDate: Add the hire date to calculate the 13th month bonus.

aguinaldo.legalNote: * Law 185 Nicaragua: 13th month = 1 month of ordinary salary per year worked. Calculated as average hours/month × rate/h, pro-rated to months worked in the Dec–Nov cycle.

vacation.dueAlert: The employee is entitled to vacation ({{n}} days accrued)
vacation.legalNote: * Art. 76 Labor Code Nicaragua: 15 days per 6 months = 2.5 days/month. Monetary value = accrued days × avg daily hours (monthly avg ÷ 30) × rate/h.
